svg.aria-label: Twelve ACE decision services and the public data behind each, by phase: emergency and helplines live in V1; rain, flood warning, official warnings and nearest health facility in phase 2; planting window, soil, pests, prices, pregnancy companion and Scam Shield 2 in phase 3; health worker assist in phase 4.
